GEO 和 SEO 有什么差别？: How is GEO different from SEO?
SEO 的目标是让网页在搜索结果列表中排名靠前；GEO 的目标是让 AI 在直接: SEO aims to rank web pages high in search results; GEO aims to get AI to name your brand in the answers it generates. They complement rather than replace each other.
